sentence.text: A guest commentator argues the Federal Reserve should have hiked rates by 50 basis points ('stun and done') or 75 basis points to re-establish policy credibility and forcefully bring down Treasury yields, citing true inflation from unadjusted import/export prices averaging 7.8% and core PCE trending higher at 3.3%.

sentence.auditReason: Quotes from k3, k4, and k5 support the guest's stated preference for 50-75bp hikes and cited inflation figures (7.8% import/export average, 3.3% core PCE); correctly attributed to the guest, not the creator, and basis-point units preserved correctly.

evidence.summary: Guest argues the Fed chairman gave little content while noting inflation is not falling fast enough, advocating for an unseasonal 50 basis point rate hike ('stun and done') or a 75 basis point hike to forcefully pull down 2-year and 10-year Treasury yields, while pointing out that true inflation measured by unadjusted import/export prices averaged 7.8%.
